name: poly_abc_distinct_roots_complex
statement: (a b : Polynomial ℂ) (hab : IsCoprime a b) (ha : 0 < a.natDegree) : a.natDegree + 1 ≤ (a * b * (a + b)).roots.toFinset.card
closed: ∀ (a b : Polynomial ℂ) (hab : IsCoprime a b) (ha : 0 < a.natDegree), a.natDegree + 1 ≤ (a * b * (a + b)).roots.toFinset.card
informal: Stothers' form over ℂ: for coprime a, b with a non-constant, the product ab(a+b) has at least deg a + 1 distinct complex roots — Uses Mathlib2.ms_mason_stothers_v2 (c = -(a+b)) to get deg a < deg rad(ab(a+b)), then show over an algebraically closed field that natDegree (radical p) equals the number of distinct roots of p (radical is the product of the distinct monic linear factors).
type: ∀ (a b : Polynomial ℂ), IsCoprime a b → 0 < a.natDegree → a.natDegree + 1 ≤ (a * b * (a + b)).roots.toFinset.card
